Sequence top-left idle, top-right windup, bottom-left impact, bottom-right recovery. Preserve original richly painted JRPG design and palette. The registrar STAMPS paperwork. Frame3 impact: arm swings DOWN, stamp planted FLAT on paperwork atop the desk, flesh folds compress naturally. Frame4 recovery: stamp lifts a little off paper, arm relaxed, mouth closes. Desk stays exactly the same size, same legs, same planted corners and same position. This is a substantial visible arm movement, not a stretching face. Keep rigid attachments fixed in size and registration. No text, no panel lines, no labels. Intentional organic changes are allowed but do not redesign the character. Silhouette and joints should change where the action requires, not stretch the whole body. Make each frame a coherent fully illustrated character including all limbs and props.
